theorems.name: Submission.exists_open_graph_domain_of_closedBall_graph
theorems.statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} (S : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ContinuousOn u (closedBall 0 s) → u 0 = 0 → S ∩ closedBall 0 s = q '' graphOver u (closedBall 0 s) ∩ closedBall 0 s → ∃ W : Set (Rn n), IsOpen W ∧ (0 : Rn n) ∈ W ∧ W ⊆ ball 0 s ∧ q.symm '' S ∩ ball 0 s = graphOver u W
